messages:
maya: quick sync: Console per-route cards now show per-model breakdowns. question: how to display fallback counts without inflating the model request metric?
eli: split event types. emit model.request for billing/usage and model.fallback for sampling/analytics. model.fallback has sample_pct so analytics can scale estimates.
sam: saved-query UX: add a small checkbox 'Include sampled fallbacks' and store sample_pct in saved-query metadata. default unchecked.
tessa: add CI to any sampled rates and mark scaled estimates as 'estimated'.
raj: platform: enforce org_max_sampling default=5%. require admin opt-in for >5% or full capture.
maya: perfect. i'll write RFC.
